parts.label: PART 1
instruction: There are seven questions in this part.
For each question, there are three pictures and a short recording.
For each question, choose the correct answer A, B or C.

items.stem: Abby first decided to go surfing when

options.text: her mother offered to teach her.
her mother gave her money for a surfboard.

items.stem: What did Abby discover when she started surfing?

options.text: Her local surfing school was expensive.
She needed more equipment than she'd expected.
It was good to try different surfboards.

items.stem: What does Abby say about surfing in the winter?

options.text: The sea is warm enough where she lives.
She wears a special suit for winter surfing.
The beaches are very quiet then.

items.stem: How did Abby feel about surfing the enormous wave?

options.text: disappointed she didn't have the right board
worried at first by the size of the wave
scared about falling off her board

items.stem: What advice does Abby give to teenagers interested in surfing?

options.text: don't start until you're a very strong swimmer
learn to surf in different conditions

items.stem: What does Abby want to do next?

options.text: find out about surfing as a career
train for the next surfing competition

parts.label: PART 2
instruction: You will hear a radio interview with a teenage surfer called Abby Fielding.
For each question, choose the correct answer A, B or C.

parts.label: PART 4
parts.scenario: Lisa and Sam — discussing a book they have both read
instruction: Look at the six sentences for this part.
You will hear a girl called Lisa and a boy called Sam talking about a book they have both read.
Decide if each sentence is correct or incorrect.
If it is correct, choose the letter A for YES. If it is not correct, choose the letter B for NO.
